title: Hyperspace countdown
description: The hyperspace countdown (RULES A.5.4, B.16.2, deliberate differences 5 and 6). Countdown holds the state; the keys, navigation, docking, death and the flight tick move it.

states.description: Counting down to a normal jump: destination System(selection), shown 15 to 1.
Counting down to a galactic jump: destination NextGalaxy.

transitions.guard: not docked; the selected system is not here and is within the fuel
not docked; a galaxy drive is fitted
transitions.action: The drive is used up and legal status cleared at the press.
The destination changes (deliberate difference 6); otherwise the old one stays.

transitions.trigger: Countdown::tick in Flight or Death mode
Countdown::tick in Flight or Death mode

transitions.action: hyperspace::jump to the next Reach and the tunnel.

transitions.trigger: cancel: docking, entering the docked state, death (deliberate difference 5) or the return to the title
